worked_example.problem: In the school office, a secretary types report cards in a word processor on a desktop computer, which prints them on a shared printer. Name the hardware, software, data and user.
steps: Hardware: the desktop computer and the printer.
Software: the word processor (and the operating system).
Data: the pupils’ marks and names.
worked_example.answer: Hardware: computer, printer. Software: word processor. Data: marks. User: secretary.

cards.idea: Hardware is the physical parts you can touch; software is the programs.
example: The keyboard is hardware; a game is software.

cards.idea: System software runs the computer; application software does jobs for the user.
example: The operating system is system software; a word processor is application software.

cards.idea: Data, users, networks and procedures complete the computing environment.
example: The school’s Wi-Fi is part of the network.

pick.t: an operating system such as Windows, Linux or Android
pick.why: System software: an operating system such as Windows, Linux or Android.

pick.t: the program that starts and runs the computer
pick.why: System software: the program that starts and runs the computer.

misconceptions.explain: System software runs the computer; application software does a job for the user.

questions.prompt: Match each component with its meaning.

pool.right: the physical parts you can touch: screen, keyboard, processor
the programs that tell the computer what to do
the facts and figures the computer works on
the people who use and look after computers
the connections that let computers share data
the rules and steps for using the system

right.text: Without programs, the hardware does not know what to do.

wrong.explain: Software gives instructions; a fan keeps it cool.
Without programs, hardware cannot do anything useful.

questions.prompt: One sentence is wrong. Which one?

right.text: A web browser is application software.
Users are part of the computing environment.
A network lets computers share data.

wrong.text: An operating system is application software.
Software can be touched with your hands.
wrong.explain: Software is programs; you touch hardware.
